Purchases of goods by Top Withholding Agents
Purchases of services by Top Withholding Agents
Commissions of brokers/agents (non-employees) — folded into the professional-fee tiers since RR 11-2018
value.rate: Individuals: 5% if annual gross ≤ ₱3M with sworn declaration, else 10%; corporations: 10% if ≤ ₱720,000, else 15%. (Legacy ATC WI515/WC515 still appears in some tables at a flat 10%.)

value.payee: Income payments by GPPs to their partners (drawings, advances, sharings, allowances)
value.rate: 10% if annual ≤ ₱720,000; 15% otherwise (individual codes only — partners are natural persons)

value.payee: TWA purchases from manufacturers or direct importers of goods intended for wholesale: motor vehicles (CBU/SKD, incl. motorcycles) and their parts/accessories, pharmaceutical products, solid/liquid fuels
value.rate: 0.5% in lieu of the 1% goods rate — RR 24-2025, effective Oct 10, 2025; supplier need only be a manufacturer OR direct importer, with documentary proof per RMC 79-2026

value.payee: E-marketplace / digital-platform and DFSP remittances to online sellers
value.rate: 0.5% of gross remittances (flat, per RR 5-2025 implementing CREATE MORE — superseding RR 16-2023's 1%-of-one-half mechanic); excluded if annual gross remittances across all platforms ≤ ₱500,000 with BIR-received sworn declaration, or BMBE-registered

value.payee: Credit-card company payments to businesses for cardholder sales
value.rate: 0.5% of the gross amounts paid (RR 5-2025; previously 1% of one-half) — the acquirer withholds and issues Form 2307

legalBasis: RR 2-98 Sec 2.57.2, as amended by RR 11-2018 & RR 7-2019
RR 16-2023, as amended by RR 5-2025 (CREATE MORE)
rates.notes: The full ATC schedule is longer; these are the rates MSMEs meet most. Top Withholding Agents: designated by published BIR list — criteria per RR 31-2020 (gross sales/receipts or purchases ≥ ₱12M for Groups A/B, ≥ ₱5M for C/D/E); obligation starts the month after list publication, and TWA status is independent of the EOPT micro/small/medium/large classification. Individual 5% professional-fee rate requires the payee's sworn declaration (gross ≤ ₱3M, non-VAT); without it, withhold 10%. Lone-payor payees with annual income ≤ ₱250,000 may be exempted by sworn declaration. Platforms' alphalist duties per RMC 55-2026.

sec34kRepealed.value: For taxable years from 2024, an expense is deductible even if the related withholding tax was not withheld or remitted — EOPT repealed NIRC Sec 34(K). The withholding agent remains liable for the unremitted tax, surcharge, and interest.
sec34kRepealed.notes: Major change from the pre-2024 deduction-disallowance regime, in force since January 22, 2024; the agent's own exposure (tax not withheld plus surcharge and interest) survives.

value.deadline: last day of the month following each calendar quarter

legalBasis: NIRC Sec 33, as amended by RA 10963
fringeBenefitsTax.notes: Applies only to fringe benefits given to managerial/supervisory employees (rank-and-file benefits run through compensation instead). No attachments ride the 1603Q. Out of the estimator's scope; surfaced on the employer checklist.
